timing: 5 Lightweight warmups and 5 Hybrid warmups, then forced Lightweight and Hybrid in alternating case order, then 5 Auto warmups and a separate Auto measurement. Repetitions are 64 at 1080p, 32 at 4K and 16 at 8K. Device-resident Queue through Ready and Release. Sample standard deviation uses n-1.
oracle: minimum of the forced Lightweight and Hybrid means. Auto timing is not the oracle.
